baseline_description: Upstream dwm 6.8 plus upstream fixes; fork baseline.
notes: Baseline verified as the upstream/local merge-base.
transient.c is an upstream diagnostic, not part of the dwm binary; it is counted as support C. dwm-spawn.c is runtime C.
The spawn/swallow branch commit b6df683 is integrated at merge 850a415 and detailed separately below.

changes.6760c0c: Track local config.h and add build-artifact ignores.
changes.630a973: Add audio/media controls and launcher configuration.
changes.8bc9886: Add configurable floating terminal launch support.
changes.fd4af73: Add Super+Shift+K keymap menu and per-tag bar visibility tracking.
changes.e27aee9: Refresh help and Brave launch fallback.
changes.409b7b0: Add runtime tag renaming; synchronize config template; update help/build script.
changes.6630daa: Add region/full-screen screenshot helpers and bindings.
changes.850a415: Merge spawn-swallow: window swallowing, dwm-spawn IPC helper, build/install integration (b6df683).
changes.6d383a5: Add suspend binding and help entry.
changes.eb26f97: Add dwm-suspend backend wrapper; refresh docs/help and maintenance instructions.
changes.600ed7c: Add Kitty and Ghostty terminal shortcuts.
changes.d36f9af: Add floating st help viewer and binding; synchronize terminal help.
changes.2dedbe3: Harden hardware helpers; add CLI bar-font override and headless helper tests.
changes.12f7473: Align fonts with session/dmenu-font policy; add Super+F1–F4 audio controls and help.
changes.13fdf83: Enable -s smart-case matching in the keymap menu.
changes.2c3a4bd: Refresh dwm/st help and bindings; separate Super+B bar toggle; shorten full-width menu; add keymap tests.
changes.8f89445: Use absolute brightness rungs; expand brightness tests and docs.
changes.9aa34ab: Fix smart-case help invocation and bogus menu entries; document copy-mode exit behavior.
changes.22c2661: Add Super+E terminal file manager via dwm-fmgr, packaging and keymap tests.
changes.937f79a: Make Super+N tag rename nonblocking with labeled prompt and pipe tests; align brightness tests/docs to current rungs.
